description: WYSIWYG editor for Azure DevOps wiki pages that writes back only the Markdown you changed.
config.wikiPath: Folder of the local git clone of the wiki (empty: the wiki of the last page opened).
config.pullOnStartup: Pull the latest version of the wiki when VS Code starts (git pull --rebase --autostash). Only works when scalpel.wikiPath is set.
view.pages.welcome:
No wiki chosen yet. Open a page in the editor, or choose the folder of your wiki clone.
[Choose wiki folder](command:scalpel.chooseWiki)
